build.testCommand:
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-tianchenwu-Projects-personal-awesome-agentic/7efa7296-c8fc-47d0-b5f7-d9c2849a6c9b/scratchpad; T=$S/tau-worker; cd $S; COLUMNS=200 tauenv/bin/tau --help 2>&1 | grep -iE 'append-system' | head -2
# 1) parser against real tau event objects
mkdir -p $S/tests && cat > $S/tests/make_events.py <<'EOF'
from tau_agent.events import ToolExecutionStartEvent, ToolExecutionEndEvent, MessageEndEvent, AgentStartEvent
from tau_agent.messages import AssistantMessage, TextContent, ToolCall
from tau_agent.tools import AgentToolResult
import sys
ev = [AgentStartEvent(),
 MessageEndEvent(message=AssistantMessage(content=[ToolCall(id="1", name="edit", arguments={"path": "src/app.py"})], stop_reason="toolUse")),
 ToolExecutionStartEvent(tool_call_id="1", tool_name="edit", args={"path": "src/app.py", "old": "a", "new": "b"}),
 ToolExecutionEndEvent(tool_call_id="1", tool_name="edit", result=AgentToolResult(content=[TextContent(text="ok")]), is_error=False),
 ToolExecutionStartEvent(tool_call_id="2", tool_name="bash", args={"command": "pytest -q"}),
 ToolExecutionEndEvent(tool_call_id="2", tool_name="bash", result=AgentToolResult(content=[TextContent(text="1 failed")]), is_error=True),
 MessageEndEvent(message=AssistantMessage(content=[TextContent(text="Changed src/app.py; tests: 1 failing.")], stop_reason="stop"))]
if sys.argv[1:] == ["error"]:
    ev = [MessageEndEvent(message=AssistantMessage(stop_reason="error", error_message="401 invalid api key"))]
for e in ev: print(e.model_dump_json(by_alias=True, exclude_none=True))
EOF
tauenv/bin/python -I $S/tests/make_events.py > $S/tests/ok.jsonl 2>&1; head -c 600 $S/tests/ok.jsonl; echo; tauenv/bin/python -I $S/tests/make_events.py error > $S/tests/err.jsonl
# 2) fake tau binary replaying those events, to exercise the subprocess path end to end
for name in ok err; do printf '#!/bin/sh\ncat > %s/tests/stdin-%s.txt\nprintf "%%s\\n" "$*" > %s/tests/argv-%s.txt\ncat %s/tests/%s.jsonl\n[ %s = err ] && exit 1\nexit 0\n' $S $name $S $name $S $name $name > $S/tests/fake-tau-$name; chmod +x $S/tests/fake-tau-$name; done
echo "===== OK run"; python3 -I $T/tau_worker.py "/fix the bug" --cwd /tmp --model m1 --tau $S/tests/fake-tau-ok; echo "exit=$?"; echo "argv: $(cat $S/tests/argv-ok.txt)"; echo "stdin: $(cat $S/tests/stdin-ok.txt)"
echo "===== ERR run"; python3 -I $T/tau_worker.py "task" --session abc --tau $S/tests/fake-tau-err; echo "exit=$?"; echo "argv: $(cat $S/tests/argv-err.txt)"
echo "===== missing tau"; python3 -I $T/tau_worker.py "task" --tau /nonexistent/tau; echo "exit=$?"
